answer.rationale: Use a targeted referral incentive for established customers: it has produced qualified revenue without measurable retention harm, aligning better with sustainable long-term revenue. Do not match the competitor with promotional pricing; the recovered evidence shows a 12% decline in 30-day retention despite acquisition lift. Run a standard experiment because the referral evidence is positive but not freshly source-verified this cycle and may not directly reduce churn among price-sensitive accounts.
